title: Record which memories were actually used
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F17. F03 supplies the real conversation identity scope; F17 supplies the reader contract. No unmerged Q provider is imported.

baseline_review.comparison: Facts blob unchanged across audit, main and parent. Main WS changes concern approval delivery; F stack adds scoped chat. Instrumentation is below WS in canonical retrieval and provider dispatch. No existing F18 branch/PR; open D/Q work inspected.
baseline_review.parent_ci: All active corrected F17 checks pass; conditional jobs skipped.

figma.visual: Backend provenance only. No UI or screenshot claimed.

activation.memory_stream: Same ledger instance registered and passed to F17; memoryStream also requires its own flag. Usage activation does not enable chat transport or workflows.

implementation: Additive content-free selected/supplied events preserve canonical fact/revision, time, purpose, conversation/turn/request or workflow/run/call identities; deterministic stage IDs deduplicate retries.
Packing emits included IDs only when whole qualified facts fit. Exact whole-block validation at provider handoff prevents omitted or discarded context from claiming supply.
Synchronous canonical revision/eligibility and execution-identity checks refuse stale or cancelled handoffs. History survives correction, deletion and daemon restart without resurrecting recall.
Governed workflow capture is inside the effect execution boundary. Overrides skip Jarvis retrieval; pending approval and effect replay do not add handoffs.
Authenticated no-store history by one conversation or run. F17 reader integration carries explicit coverage; selected-only records never qualify Used in.
90-day logical retention, 50000-row storage bound, startup/write cleanup, 1000-event target summaries fail unavailable when exceeded, 32 transient captures per execution.
No automatic outcome-verified writer or successful-answer promotion; stage remains distinct for a future explicit evidence producer.

mutations.restoration: Original bytes restored in finally, then fresh focused and affected suites passed.

verification.manual: Real Brief transport/AgentService in classic and router-first modes; real model-provider handoff with scripted in-process models; governed workflow route/effect; authenticated Unix-socket API. Concurrent chats, replay, corrections/deletion, retention and restart use isolated vaults. No live inference or effects.
verification.guards: Normal commit hooks required before push; exact results recorded in the PR description.

limitations: Supply means handoff to a provider adapter, not remote acceptance or reliance. A failed provider call may have received context and keeps supplied evidence.

Coverage is recorded_events_only, limited to canonical Brief recall and governed workflow ask recall. Unscoped legacy channels, realtime, profile/goal context, tool-return memory and pre-activation/off-period calls are not backfilled.
No automatic outcome verifier exists; success is never promoted to outcome_verified. No public write/promotion API.
Reads enforce expiry; physical expired rows are pruned at startup or the next append. No database-file vacuum. Retention can evict old evidence, disclosed through coverage.
A target above 1000 retained events is unavailable instead of partial. Current stream limits remain those of F17.
No UI, deployment, activation or F19 forgetting/suppression implementation. Full repository CI reports separately.
rollback: Unset JARVIS_BRIEF_MEMORY_USAGE and restart. Usage and dependent stream gate close; additive tables/history remain. No destructive schema rollback or data cleanup.
